result.markdown:
For most small teams, **I'd recommend HubSpot CRM as the best overall choice.** It's relatively easy to learn, has a useful free version, and can grow with your business.

However, the best CRM depends on whether you're primarily managing sales, customer relationships, leads, or ongoing client accounts.

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

## Best CRMs for small teams

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

- Free option available for up to 2 users
- Contact and lead management
- Sales pipelines and email tracking
- Marketing and customer service tools

Best for: Small businesses wanting an all-around CRM that can scale.

[Explore HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

- Very visual sales pipeline
- Tracks leads and deals
- Sales activity reminders
- Easy to see where every opportunity stands

Best for: Teams focused on closing deals and following up with prospects.

[Explore Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

- Free option for up to 3 users
- Custom workflows and automation
- Reporting and analytics
- Integrates with other Zoho products

Best for: Budget-conscious businesses that want flexibility.

[Explore Zoho CRM](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

(Best for communication)

- Email, phone and chat capabilities
- Lead scoring
- Sales automation
- Affordable entry-level plans

Best for: Teams that communicate with lots of prospects and customers.

[Explore Freshsales](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

**5\. Less Annoying CRM**

(Best for simplicity)

- Straightforward interface
- Contact management
- Calendar and task tracking
- Simple pricing structure

Best for: Small teams that don't want complicated software.

[Explore Less Annoying CRM](https://www.lessannoyingcrm.com/)

Approximate advertised starting prices in USD, generally with annual billing.

| CRM | Starting price |
|--------|--------|
| HubSpot | Free; paid from \~\$20/seat |
| Pipedrive | \~\$14/user/month |
| Zoho CRM | \~\$14/user/month |

| Less Annoying CRM | \~\$15/user/month |


Pricing and free-plan limits can change by plan and billing terms. ## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business today\:

- **HubSpot\:** Best all-around starting point.
- **Pipedrive\:** Best if sales is your primary focus.
- **Zoho\:** Best if keeping costs down is important.
